description: This file defines the 'SiloBuilder' class used for configuring an Orleans server within the Orleans.Hosting namespace. The class provides properties for dependency injection services and configuration settings, and initializes default silo services upon instantiation.

classes.name: SiloBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring an Orleans server, implementing the ISiloBuilder interface, encapsulating service collection and configuration.

methods.name: SiloBuilder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SiloBuilder with service collection and configuration, and adds default silo services.
